title: From Immersion to Incorporation
role: SYNTHESIS CHAPTER — introduces the term 'incorporation' as the volume's synthetic resolution to the four conceptual challenges of Ch.2; integrates the 6-dimensional Player Involvement Model (PIM) + macro/micro temporal phase apparatus under a single experientially-grounded metaphor; grounds the framework in Lakoff+Johnson experientialism + Damasio cognitive-neuroscience; offers two participant-interview vignettes (Rheric/Guild Wars; Kumacho/Planetside) demonstrating incorporation in practice; closes by re-deriving the resolution of all four Ch.2 challenges via the incorporation construct.
